scope.purpose: Define how project information becomes a formal submission, a declared deliverable, and an accepted handover asset suitable for a stated purpose.
sections: S7.4 LOD / LOI and Permitted Reliance

requirements.statement: Only Published information may be relied upon for declared uses.
Submission does not imply acceptance; acceptance must be recorded through controlled review and sign-off.
Every submission shall declare intended use, deliverable scope, LOD/LOI level, and target milestone.
Information containers submitted for formal exchange shall pass internal discipline quality verification and coordination checks before issue.
Information shall not be used beyond its declared governed purpose.
Handover deliverables shall include certified as-built models, record drawings, asset registers, and operations/maintenance information.
Asset data delivered at handover shall conform to governed asset/lifecycle schemas.
All formal exchanges and handover submissions shall be registered and tracked in the project transmittal registry.
